title: introduce-invocation-initialization-annotator-and-cohort-cost-dashboard
author: Marcus Nguyen
release_notes: Adds invocation-initialization annotation to traces/metrics and a dashboard that isolates initialization-attributed latency and token cost cohorts. Opt-in via config flag; no public API changes.
description: Context: Ops and oncall have been chasing small groups of invocations with elevated P95 latency and token cost that correlate with initialization-like behavior (e.g., first use of a large static prefix, explicit client session bootstrap, or kernel cold-paths). Existing telemetry mixes these with normal traffic which hampers RCA. This PR: (1) Adds an invocation initialization annotator in the runtime that heuristically detects initialization signals (first-KV misses, disproportionate prefix tokens, explicit X-Redwood-Init header). The annotator is tuned for precision and emits invocation.initialized=true on the root span and as a metric label. (2) Exposes derived metrics: invocation.init_ratio, invocation.init_latency_p50/p95, invocation.init_token_cost. (3) Ships a compact cohort-cost dashboard with an initialization cohort heatmap, per-model init-ratio table, and a waterfall showing init-attributed token-cost by client. (4) Adds an alert rule that suppresses long-tail SLO noise by default and a distinct init-impact alert that triggers when init-attributed P95 > 2x baseline and accounts for >12% of token spend in a 30m window. Files: runtime/annotators/init_annotator.go; tracing/enrich_init.go; telemetry/metrics/init_schema.yaml; observability/dashboards/init-cohort-dashboard.jsonnet; observability/alerts/init-impact.yaml; docs/ops/init-observability.md; sdk/ts/examples/init_header_demo.ts; tests/init/annotator_test.go; tests/e2e/init_cohort_sim.go. Rollout: feature flag (observability.init_annotation) with staged canary (10 hosts) -> 30% -> full. Ops guidance added in runbook doc. Backwards compatibility: additive only; disabling feature flag reverts annotations. Future: collect labeled corpus and iterate on a classifier-backed annotator.
commits: 3 commits: add annotator + unit tests; trace enrichment and metric wiring; dashboard + alerts + docs

post_merge_tasks: metrics-schema migration applied; dashboard deployed to observability canary org; alert staged; ops notified in #observability with runbook link
notes_for_oncall: If init-impact alert triggers: (1) check invocation.init_ratio and per-model init_token_cost panels; (2) inspect compact trace for invocation.initialized attribute; (3) correlate with recent client prefix/template rollouts; (4) temporarily disable observability.init_annotation flag if needed; (5) whitelist known client IDs or increase alert threshold. See docs/ops/init-observability.md for queries and runbook steps.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover edge cases in the annotator heuristics (sparse prefixes, false positives). E2E sim creates mixed steady-state and init-like traffic and validates metric emission, dashboard values, and alert suppression behavior. Canary run (72h) reported init_ratio ~1.8% and no spurious alerts after threshold tuning.
